item.title: Show HN: See what your Linux machine measured at boot (through TPM eventlog)
item.summary: Vibe coded a web eventlog parser to show all the linux boot events (from secure boot variables to grub commands being run). If you have a TPM (most systems do) in you machines, you should be able to get an eventlog. Eventlog is processed in your browser and won't be uploaded Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49317569 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
